AS REQ (ON WHENEVER IN RAIN, SNOW, OR VISIBLE MOISTURE)

items.text: If fire is not extinguished, increase airspeed to an incombustible mixture.

items.response: SIDE SLIP AWAY FROM THE FUEL TANK AND CABIN

items.text: IF FIRE OUT & ELECTRIC IS NECESSARY FOR CONTINUED FLIGHT (i.e. I.F.R.& I.M.C.) THEN:

items.response: ON ONE AT A TIME, WITH DELAY UNTIL FAULT FOUND
CHECK BOTH/OR START IF PROP IS STOPPED
65 KIAS FLAPS UP; 60 KIAS FLAP DOWN

items.text: If low voltage light illuminates again:
A preheated engine is required before starting during cool, cold, or winter operations. Ensure oil temp. is in the green or is moving before engine run-up and mag checks are attempted.
